notes.title: EVERYTHING EXPLOSIVE'S ANNIVERSARY + UPDATE DETAILS
notes.notes:
TODAY IS EVERYTHING EXPLOSIVE'S FIRST ANNIVERSARY!

An update will be arriving next week that will heavily improve the core gameplay.

FEATURES:


 Completely redesigned weapon pickup


 Resdesigned AI

 AI will hide from opponents and get cover whenever in combat



 Polished interaction with weapons, crates, and shard shops 


 Added all weapons to crates


 Grenades and drones tweaked


 Weapon accuracy heavily improved


 Redesigned ammo system for weapons


 Added recoil to some weapons


 Changed day/night lighting system


 Bomb Buggy tweaked


SEASON 2 DETAILS

Season 2 will feature a fully updated artstyle, a myriad of map changes, new gameplay mechanics, and much more. A new live event will soon be announced to transition into Season 2. Here's a sneak peek.

notes.title: FREE PRESENT COSMETIC! EXPLOSIVE HARSH WINTER UPDATE
notes.notes:
A limited time free present cosmetic is available in Everything Explosive's shop. Mix and Match it with your character.


Santa is here, and Harsh Winter came with him. The map is covered with snow, ice, and Glacier Guardians. These foes are ordinary snowmen that will become monsters when disturbed. Available in Battle Royale and Capture the Frag.

NEW WEAPON: FROSTED LAUNCHER

A Rocket that turns into ice. If an opponent is hit by the ice, they will freeze temporarily. Available in shard shops.

NEW COSMETICS: 


 Winter Present (Free)


 Glacier Guardian


 Jolly Ol' Santa


 Jolly Ol' Hat


CHANGES:

 Fireball Launcher's fire will go out faster


 The middle island is Christmas themed


 AI will now show the amount damage done when hit

notes.notes:

notes.title: EVERYTHING EXPLOSIVE HALLOWEEN UPDATE
notes.notes:
The HALLOWEEN Update is here and the Pumpkin Slayer is tracking you down. 

Ring doorbells to get a trick or a treat, and beware of fog that can reveal enemies' locations. Try the new Frag-O-Lantern which fires projectiles in each direction!

https://youtu.be/Jx3o9nx-UO8

CHANGES

 Some locations are decorated for the occasion!


 The Middle Island is Halloween Themed


 Minor bug fixes


 New Skins and a Mix/Match Jack-O-Lantern


 The map is dark, as well as for Capture the Frag


 Capture the Frag now has Trick or Treating for more weapons, Frag-O-Lanterns, and Pumpkin Slayers.


 Many other Halloween changes.

notes.title: PORTUGUESE LANGUAGE NOW SUPPORTED! Everything Explosive Rampage Update
notes.notes: A new language can now be selected in Everything Explosive! The translations are new, and may be a bit rough around the edges. Please post on the steam community or on Everything Explosive's discord (Link In-Game) if a translation should be changed.

notes.title: BIGGEST UPDATE OF SEASON 1! EVERYTHING EXPLOSIVE RAMPAGE UPDATE
notes.notes:
THE CITY IS IN FLAMES.

An unidentified group of delinquents have blown up the bank. Explore multiple brand new locations, and show who is the most OP!

CHANGES


 OVERPOWERED LTM: Powerups fall from the sky and land on the middle island. Combined can show how OP you are against your opponents. Buffed Health and special abilities on OP items.


 Shambles updated. Visit it to unlock the first page of the story!


 Many graphical improvements


 Something is in construction near the shambles.


 Audio settings, changed graphics settings, Language settings.


 Portuguese language added!


 Interaction with all items improved. Will be further improved next update.


 The Target Practice LTM will stay! It now replaces practice.


 AI have a shooting animation.


 Death Spheres completely revamped


 Connection improvements


 NOTE: Everything Explosive now runs on the most updated version of Unreal Engine. If you are running at unstable FPS, you may receive a fatal error. Choose your graphics settings to what fits best.


 Grenade's look changed.


 New footstep sounds for sand and metal.


 Middle Island changed!


 Improvements in ALL modes.


Next update will be the HallowEEn update! Bugs that are reported will be fixed in this update. At the moment, the RAMPAGE UPDATE is the biggest update of Season 1, but this new update will be much, much larger of an update.

notes.title: UPDATE YOUR GAME SO YOU CAN SEE THE LIVE EVENT ON AUGUST 15TH, 3 PM ET!
notes.notes:
In order for you to have the viewing experience, you must have an updated game beforehand. To be sure your game is up to date, your lobby should look like this after logging in. The News should be the same, too. If you don't see these, please restart steam. When hitting play, you should also see The Live Event gamemode, which isn't active until one hour before The Live Event. Be sure to look at the middle island during The Live Event.

notes.title: TIME BOMBS! EVERYTHING EXPLOSIVE FEATURE UPDATE
notes.notes:
The villains have created a new weapon to use in battle while they continue their plan.
The Live Event is in August. The date will be announced in a week or two.

Time Bombs last 60 seconds until dealing 150 damage once activated. This weapon cost three shards in the shard shop (Battle Royale) and can be found in crates.

Two new cosmetics, including the first hat! You can also buy 100 Flames for only 1 dollar!
